Things that make you soo irresistible to me!

01.

The way you understand me, even when I don't understand myself. Somehow, you always seem to know what my heart is trying to say.

02.

The way I can tell you anything and still feel like I could be loved afterwards. With you, I never feel like I have to hide the messy parts of me.

03.

The way we slip into our indirect conversations without even trying, like we have our own little language. We don't need roleplay, babyy—roleplay needs us. 😭

04.

The way you send your silly selfies and voice notes throughout the day—oh wait, you don't. 😭 You really should start, because I would happily have little pieces of you scattered throughout my day.

05.

That ridiculously red, blushy face on our first date. I don't think you realise how deeply that little moment stayed with me. 😭

06.

The way you flirt with me and somehow still make my heart race every single time. I could listen to you flirt with me forever, so please, never stop. 😭

07.

The way every little problem seems to disappear the second I see your text. Somehow, you make even my worst days feel a little lighter.

08.

The way you start giving me health advice the second you find out I've skipped a meal. 😭 I don't know what's cuter—the lecture or knowing that you care enough to give it.

09.

The way you remember every little detail about me, even the things I mention once and forget about. I love being known by you in all those tiny ways.

10.

The way, in this huge, beautiful world filled with so many people, I somehow found you.
Out of all the places we could've been, all the people we could've met, somehow our paths crossed—and honestly, that's my favourite plot twist of all. ❤️

and a thousand more that I ran out of room for! ♡

For you, my love ♡

Happyyy boyfriend's dayyy babbyyyy!!❤️ I can't believe that I am writing this to you, that I finally have someone to write to, finally someone to listen to me and to love me in ways I did not even know existed. Tbh I never ever thought that I could ever be so deeply loved by someone, but now that I know how it feels, I never wanna go back! And even tho it's been quite a while since we have confessed and that we have been expressing our feelings to each other now, it still feels soo unreal... From being just friends to late night trauma bonding, from asking each other's types to finally being each other's type, and you changing your type from a mallu girl with fair complexion to someone with a loveable heart😭 (Yahh I noticed the shift in priorities😭) I've seen myself change in past few months, and honestly I think that you make me a better version of myself, ab tak maine sirf suna tha, to love someone that makes you fall in love with yourself, and I always thought to myself ki how is this possible, until I experienced it myself, that how the right person can make you let go of all your insecurities. Tere sath na jaane kaise sab kuch possible lagne lagta hai, meri family ne itna try kiya but mujhe neet repursue krne ke liye convince nhi kr paaye, but you have a charm that's something else, something I've never seen before -(Isliye toh I call you my prince charming😭)- Nobody could bring back the confidence that I had lost, except you, and that's what makes you soo extraordinarily special. Having you makes me feel like all the sky of my life that was till now filled with fog has finally cleared, the dark nights of winter have come to an end and that my life is finally in spring, the season of bloom. You're my spring, Aditya... You're my spring! Waise Aditya means the sun right? And you call me your sunshine, aren't we just perfect?😭 Dekh I don't know what the future holds for us, but all I know is that I would move heaven and earth if it means that I could be with you forever, and I really mean it. I would always want to be the person whom you tell how your day was, to always be there to listen to you, to ask you hypothetical questions in the middle of the night and making fake scenarios with you in my mind the whole day, to always admire you for the kind of person you are and for that ridiculously intelligent brain of yours😭 To always get inspired from your ideologies and sometimes change mine too😭 I want you to feel at home when you're around me, I want you to know that even in the worst times, you'll always have me, always! I loveee youu sooo muchhh Aditya, and I don't think that there are enough words for me to express just how much I love you! ❤️

Will you be my constant? Always and forever?
Bcz I can't imagine a forever without you in it!

~With lotss of love and hugs and kisses
Your sunshine!
